statements.t: On October 27, 2026, the Board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share, which the Company plans to distribute on November 13, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 6, 2026.

In addition, on October 27, 2026, the Board declared a special cash dividend (1) of $2.00 per share, totaling approximately $106 million, which the Company plans to distribute on November 20, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 9, 2026.
The Company reaffirmed its guidance for the full year 2026, as updated last quarter.

The Company does not provide reconciliations of its outlook for cash cost of sales (free-on-board port) to cost of sales in reliance on the unreasonable efforts exception provided for under Item 10(e)(1)(i)(B) of Regulation S-K.
The Company is unable, without unreasonable efforts, to forecast certain items required to develop the meaningful comparable Generally Accepted Accounting Principles ("GAAP") measure, cost of sales.
